name: echoes-of-the-abyss
description: Browser-native RTS with acoustic fog of war set in the Pelagion Rift

scripts.dev: npm run preflight && npm run build:shared && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm -w packages/backend run dev" "npm -w packages/frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run preflight && npm run build:shared && npm -w packages/frontend run build && npm -w packages/backend run build
scripts.test: npm run preflight && npm run build:shared && npm -w packages/shared run test --if-present && npm -w packages/frontend run test --if-present && npm -w packages/backend run test --if-present && npm run test:roadmap
scripts.type-check: npm run build:shared && npm -w packages/shared run type-check && npm -w packages/frontend run type-check && npm -w packages/backend run type-check
scripts.lint: npm -w packages/shared run lint && npm -w packages/frontend run lint && npm -w packages/backend run lint
